q: Global bifurcations (homoclinic/heteroclinic connections) cannot be detected by local normal forms. The most important tool is:
opts: The Melnikov function or Lin's method (for computing distances between stable/unstable manifolds)
exp: Global bifurcations involving homoclinic/heteroclinic orbits require measurement of manifold separations globally. Melnikov's method (for near-integrable systems) and Lin's method (general) provide these measurements and predict the bifurcation values.
